svg.title: Cecil's honest-resolution bar ends far short of the target as Riju pauses.
svg.desc: A short blue result bar stops more than twenty percentage points before the target marker. Cecil reports the gap while Riju pauses on the way to the archive tables prepared for the overnight reconciliation drive.
svg.text: Page 21, panel 6 · Wide low shot across Cecil's calculation towards the opening conference-room door

text.tspan: Cecil calculates the honestly resolved share and
shows that it remains more than twenty percentage
